response.overview: We witness Hakan and Pervin, a couple leading a modest life, arguing while having breakfast at home. Hakan leaves the house in a rage, while Pervin secretly calls someone named Mustafa. We realize Pervin is attempting to cheat, but Hakan finishes work early and returns home ahead of schedule. Hearing sounds coming from the bedroom, Hakan struggles to control his anger. Yet, things are not quite as they seem; we should not act without listening to what people have to say.
response.tagline: Not everything is as it seems. We shouldn't act without listening to people.
response.title: Sor ve Dinle
